title: Format a Blog Post Excerpt
description: Mark up a text snippet with emphasis, abbreviations, quotes, and a code example.
problemStatement:
You are given a raw text excerpt. Convert it into rich HTML using the appropriate tags we learned.

Raw text: 
"Important Update: Our new feature (the 'Smart Scheduler') will be released on June 15th. The old version (v2.1) is now deprecated – use <smart-scheduler> tag only. As the documentation says: 'Always update to the latest API'. Remember: status quo is no longer acceptable. To check your version, type npm -v in the terminal. For details, visit the HTML spec."

Requirements:
- Wrap the first sentence in a paragraph. Use `<strong>` for "Important Update".
- Mark the product name "Smart Scheduler" with `<b>`.
- Use `<del>` for "deprecated" and `<ins>` for "use <smart-scheduler> tag" (yes, display the angle‑bracketed tag as text – you'll need entities!).
- Turn the quote "Always update..." into an inline `<q>`.
- Mark "status quo" with `<i>` and add a `lang="la"` attribute.
- Display the terminal command `npm -v` with `<code>`.
- Wrap "HTML spec" with an `<abbr>` that shows "HyperText Markup Language" on hover.

Be creative but fulfil all requirements. Ensure the `<smart-scheduler>` appears as literal text.
hints: Use `<` and `>` to display angle brackets inside the text.
Don't forget to close all tags properly.
expectedOutput: A paragraph with all specified formatting, displaying the literal tag name <smart-scheduler> correctly, and the abbreviation expansion visible on hover.
solutionCode: Important Update: Our new feature (the Smart Scheduler) will be released on June 15th. The old version (v2.1) is now deprecated use <smart-scheduler> tag only. As the documentation says: Always update to the latest API. Remember: status quo is no longer acceptable. To check your version, type npm -v in the terminal. For details, visit the HTML spec.
